E2910

`reactive.{kind}` needs a lambda, not {type}.

What

`reactive.{kind}` needs a lambda, not {type}.

Why

`reactive.derived`/`reactive.autorun` build a reactive value from a `fn() { … }` body so it can re-run when a signal changes. A non-lambda argument has nothing to re-run.

Fix

Write `reactive.derived(fn() { … } )` or `reactive.autorun(fn() { … })`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2910: tests/ui/button_metadata_needs_click.stderr.

Error [jet.ReactiveArgumentNotLambda]: `button` with a shortcut or label needs its click lambda
  --> tests/ui/button_metadata_needs_click.jet:6:14
    |
  6 |     node: ui.button("Save", label: "Save the file")
    |              ^^^^^^
 Why: The shortcut and accessible label belong to the click form, whose handler is the `fn() { … }` argument after them
 Fix: Write `ui.button("Save", shortcut: …, fn() { save() })`
